flows.name: Stripe - Create SetupIntent
flows.description: Creates a standalone off_session Stripe SetupIntent for the authenticated user without charging or changing subscriptions.

flows.name: Stripe - Finalize Card Setup
flows.description: Verifies a Stripe SetupIntent succeeded and belongs to the authenticated customer before returning the attached PaymentMethod.

flows.name: Stripe - Set Default Payment Method
flows.description: Verifies card ownership and sets the payment method as default on both the Stripe customer and active/trialing subscription.

existingFlowEnhancements.name: Stripe - Get Payment Methods
existingFlowEnhancements.description: Lists saved card payment methods for the authenticated user along with verified default/renewal metadata.

operations.name: Get Customer Subscriptions for Renewal Card

existingFlowEnhancements.name: Stripe - Detach Payment Method
existingFlowEnhancements.description: Verifies card ownership and blocks detaching the active subscription renewal card before detaching from Stripe.
